sentence: We should think about other ways of getting to school if the bus is full.
synonym: consider different methods of travelling to school
synonymNote: 两者都表示考虑去学校的其他方式，意思相同。

distractors.note: 意思相反，表示忘记上学，不能替换。

distractors.word: stop trying to get to school
distractors.note: 表示放弃去学校，意思完全不同。
表示谈论校舍，与交通方式无关。
